mapper.select: select count(id) from position where status = #{status}
select count(id) from position_apply where status = #{status}
select count(id) from work_hour where status = #{status}
select count(id) from settlement where status = #{status}
select ifnull(sum(sd.amount), 0) from settlement_detail sd inner join settlement s on s.id = sd.settlement_id where sd.work_date = #{date} and s.status <> 3

select p.name as position_name, d.name as dept_name, p.quota as quota, p.hired as hired, ifnull(sum(case when wh.status = 2 then wh.hours else 0 end), 0) as hours, ifnull(sum(case when wh.status = 2 then wh.hours * p.hourly_wage else 0 end), 0) as amount from position p left join dept d on d.id = p.dept_id left join work_hour wh on wh.position_id = p.id group by p.id, p.name, d.name, p.quota, p.hired, p.hourly_wage order by hours desc, p.id asc
select ifnull(nullif(p.category, ''), '未分类') as name, count(p.id) as cnt from position p group by ifnull(nullif(p.category, ''), '未分类') order by cnt desc

select d.name as dept_name, ifnull(sum(case when wh.status = 2 then wh.hours else 0 end), 0) as hours, ifnull(sum(case when wh.status = 2 then wh.hours * p.hourly_wage else 0 end), 0) as amount from dept d left join work_hour wh on wh.dept_id = d.id left join position p on p.id = wh.position_id group by d.id, d.name order by amount desc, d.id asc
